sloka: तस्योरसि निमग्नाश्च शरा बर्हिणवाससः।हस्ताच्चापि परिभ्रष्टा पपातोर्व्यां महागदा।आयुधानि च सर्वाणि विप्रकीर्यन्त भूतले ।। ६.६७.१०८ ।।
transliteration: tasyorasi nimagnāśca śarā barhiṇavāsasaḥ।hastāccāpi paribhraṣṭā papātorvyāṁ mahāgadā।āyudhāni ca sarvāṇi viprakīryanta bhūtale ।। 6.67.108 ।।

translations.english: "You have exhibited your valour without fear in battle, challenging me who has conquered even Lord of Death without difficulty in battle."
